name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in complex scenes better than generic upscalers, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality without extra compute. Trade-off: depth-aware models can struggle with flat textures or stylized art where depth cues are weak.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem isn’t detail loss—it’s motion artifacts bleeding into faces during upscaling. RealVisXL’s face upscaler won’t touch those artifacts either; it only sharpens static faces, not the dynamic distortions EXCAVA produces. Test it: run EXCAVA’s worst motion frames through InstantX’s upscaler and check if face fidelity improves—if not, the artifact isn’t detail loss, it’s motion corruption.
